# Valid fixtures

Hand-written, structurally-representative `.s`/`.block` scripts used to exercise
`parse()`'s zero-false-positive guarantee (SC-001). These are **not** verbatim
third-party production scripts — the real fixture corpus's sourcing/licensing
question is still open (see `research.md` §3 and `tasks.md` T049). Each file here
reproduces a structural *shape* found in real scripts, not their actual content.

Replace these with the real, rights-cleared corpus once that question resolves
(T049), preferring any fixture here that the real corpus doesn't already cover
by shape.
